text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering October, the student-led 
Halloween event at the academy was buzzing 
with excitement... or so it seemed—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! The once-a-year Prank Festival 
has officially begun!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Waaa!? The lantern's light went out~~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
A-At least let me ask "trick or treat" 
first, please...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Wahahaha~! I'm gonna keep running wild~!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've gone a bit too far with your 
mischief, Windy. No one has the right to 
ruin everyone's entertainment, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As Worldwide Windy's partner, I can't just 
overlook this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai!? Gaaah, I'm not gonna listen 
to what you say today either!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Then there's no helping it. Special 
Move—Pearl Diamond Waikiki Beach World 
Dance Floor!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-Whoaaa~!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You caught Windy for me, Pearl-senpai?! 
Whew, you really saved me there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Windy...! You're spending the 
entire day reflecting on what you did!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Non, non. Could you hold off on that 
punishment for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Causing trouble for others is a No—but! 
Having the passion to enjoy the event is 
totally OK!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this child's passion—I'll take 
custody of it! Let's go, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha, that is so, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah!? H-Hey!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear~, a piece of the pumpkin chipped 
off...! What am I gonna do about this...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Windy. If it were you... how 
would you prank someone in that situation?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! If it were Windy-chan, I'd riddle 
every single pumpkin here with even more 
bite marks and holes, got that?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I see. But... if it were me, I'd take 
it a step further!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll connect the carved holes with 
illumination lights—and make these 
rainbow-glowing pumpkins dance in the air 
like dragons!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat!? That sounds amazing, nano~?!

text_block_list.name: Surprised Students
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whaaat!? The pumpkin is... soaring 
through the air like a dragon!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Enchanting even the ones you play a trick 
on! Now that is what a world-class trick 
is all about!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... I'm gonna make something even 
more amazing! We'll drape ghost cloths 
over tons of balloons and throw a Big 
Scare Ghost Parade!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nice inspiration! Heheh... When we team 
up, the possibilities are infinite!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the whirlwind that bites at the 
world! Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What!? Over there... isn't the crowd 
going totally wild?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Let's go check it out too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Th-Things sure got out of hand, huh...!
choice_data_list: Still, looks like everyone's having fun.

text_block_list.text: Th-Things sure got out of hand, huh...!

Still, looks like everyone's having fun.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...When you get beaten that thoroughly, 
you can't even complain. Man, that was 
seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! A magic show you can only 
see once a year on Halloween... Burn it 
into your memories before you go home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was that even a trick, or just straight-up 
magic...? Thanks to that unbelievable 
performance, Halloween was livelier than 
ever before!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...When you get beaten that thoroughly, 
you can't even complain. Man, that was 
seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! An ever-changing, limitless 
illusion! Inviting everyone to a world of 
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With one overwhelming performance after 
another... the Academy's Halloween turned 
out to be a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...When you get beaten that thoroughly, 
you can't even complain. Man, that was 
seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all, and enjoy Worldwide 
Windy's Halloween Magic Show to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—an endless barrage of performances 
known as "pranks" captivated the entire 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you got influenced by her too!? 
Guess I'd expect nothing less from her 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, you come over here too! With 
our combined trick-or-treat magic, we'll 
get everyone's passion to a fever pitch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing the gallery to the fullest with a 
magical performance what a truly 
world-class Halloween looks like.
